name: mock-fireprox
description: Mock AWS API Gateway mimicking FireProx (github.com/ustayready/fireprox) for local end-to-end tests. Forwards /api/* and /uploads/* to https://boppy.me while injecting AWS-like headers (X-Amzn-Trace-Id) and honoring the X-My-X-Forwarded-For convention (copied into X-Forwarded-For).
